privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: SentiNews is an academic research project developed as part of the Bachelor's thesis "Development and Study of an Automated System and Web Platform for Topic Classification and Sentiment Analysis of News Articles" at Astana IT University. This Privacy Policy explains in plain language what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have. The platform is operated for educational and research purposes only.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: SentiNews is an academic media-monitoring platform created by Nurasyl Kairkhanov and Akezhan Meirkhanov, students of Astana IT University, as part of their diploma project. The platform is non-commercial and is intended for research, demonstration, and educational use.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect only the minimum amount of data needed to operate the service:
bullets: Account data: your name, email address, password (stored as a salted bcrypt hash), preferred language, and avatar (if you sign in with Google).
Authentication data: refresh tokens, the device/browser that issued them and your IP address. This is used to power Active Sessions in your profile.
Project data: project names, search keywords and aliases, and other settings you choose.
Public news content: the platform fetches and stores publicly available news articles (title, URL, publication date, source, language, country, author when available).

sections.title: How we use your data
paragraphs: We use your data only to provide the platform's features:
bullets: To authenticate you and protect your account.
To collect and analyse public news mentions for the topics you create.
To compute analytics: sentiment, topics, geographical distribution, sources, influencers, and time-series.
To send transactional emails such as email verification codes.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: We do not use third-party tracking cookies. The platform stores access and refresh tokens, your selected language, theme, and the "Remember me" preference in your browser's localStorage so the website can remember you between visits.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: To collect and analyse news, the platform sends queries to the following external APIs. We do not share your account data with them — only your search keywords:
bullets: OpenAI API — used for sentiment analysis and AI summaries.
Google OAuth — optional, used only if you choose to sign in with Google.
News APIs: NewsAPI.org, SerpAPI (Google News), NewsData.io, Event Registry (NewsAPI.ai), World News API.
SMTP provider — used to deliver verification emails.

sections.title: How we store your data
paragraphs: All account and project data is stored in a PostgreSQL database hosted in a controlled academic environment. Passwords are never stored in plain text — only as a bcrypt hash. We do not sell, rent, or share personal data with any third party for advertising or commercial purposes.

sections.title: Data retention
paragraphs: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. You can delete your account at any time from Profile → Settings → Delete account, which permanently removes your account, sessions, and projects.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Because SentiNews is an academic project, you can at any time:
bullets: View and edit your profile in Profile → Settings.
Sign out of any active session.
Change your password.
Delete your account along with all associated data.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: Because this is a research project, the platform and this policy may change as the project evolves. The latest version is always available at this page, and the date at the top reflects the most recent update.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, you can contact the project authors directly.
contact.authors: SentiNews — Bachelor's diploma project. Authors: Nurasyl Kairkhanov & Akezhan Meirkhanov, Astana IT University.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of SentiNews, an academic web platform for automatic news monitoring, topic classification, and sentiment analysis. The platform was developed as part of the Bachelor's diploma project "Development and Study of an Automated System and Web Platform for Topic Classification and Sentiment Analysis of News Articles" at Astana IT University.

sections.title: About the service
paragraphs: SentiNews is a non-commercial, educational web platform. It allows authorised users to create projects on a topic or brand, collect publicly available news articles in English, Russian, and Kazakh, and view automated analytics such as sentiment, topics, geography, sources, and influencers.

sections.title: Eligibility and accounts
paragraphs: To use the service you must be at least 16 years old. You agree to provide accurate information during registration and to keep your password confidential. You are responsible for all activity that happens under your account.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: By using SentiNews, you agree NOT to:
bullets: Use the platform for any unlawful purpose or in a way that could harm individuals or organisations.
Attempt to gain unauthorised access to other accounts, the database, or the underlying servers.
Try to overload, disrupt, or interfere with the platform's normal operation.
Re-publish or sell the analytical data produced by the platform for commercial purposes without prior consent of the authors.

sections.title: Content and data sources
paragraphs: News articles displayed in the platform are fetched from publicly available sources via official APIs (NewsAPI.org, SerpAPI, NewsData.io, Event Registry, World News API). All article rights remain with their original publishers. SentiNews shows only a short excerpt and a link to the original article.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The source code, design, analytical models, and documentation of SentiNews belong to the authors of the diploma project. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the platform for personal, academic, or research purposes.

sections.title: Disclaimer of warranties
paragraphs: The platform is provided "as is" and "as available" for academic and demonstration purposes. The authors make no warranties about uptime, accuracy of sentiment scores, completeness of collected mentions, or fitness for any specific business purpose. Analytical results should not be treated as professional advice.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the authors of the project shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the platform. Because the platform is non-commercial, the authors' total liability is limited to providing access to the diploma project's source code and documentation.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms as the diploma project evolves. The most recent version is always published on this page. By continuing to use the platform after changes are posted, you agree to the updated Terms.
